{{Quote|Where was your "protection" when we needed it?|Sej Verlin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Sej Verlin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and a member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He complained to Republic ambassador [[Alya Selray]] when the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] under [[Monta Drai]] kidnapped Balmorran citizens to sell them into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].
